component.name: Plume
component.summary: Featherweight system monitor with live graphs

description.p: Plume shows what your computer is doing, per process and system-wide, with smoothly animated graphs that cost almost nothing to draw.

ul.li: CPU, Memory, Disk and Network tabs with per-process columns and live summaries
Intel, NVIDIA and AMD GPU monitoring that never wakes a sleeping laptop GPU
Floating readouts that stay on top (with the Plume Floats shell extension)
Time scales from 30 seconds to one hour, globally or per floating readout
End, kill, stop, continue and re-prioritise processes, with PID-reuse protection
Light, dark, OLED black, Tokyo Night, Solarized, Nord, Gruvbox, Dracula, Catppuccin and more

screenshot.caption: CPU tab with per-process usage and live CPU load

description.p: GPU-rendered graphs with exact, thin lines and even motion; stable layout; a much faster process list; real Intel/AMD engine utilisation and per-process GPU; an OLED Black theme.
